about: Lower Dardenne Creek drains about 63 square miles, all of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 640 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 420 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Belleau Creek, Dardenne Creek, Cole Creek and Spencer Creek. St. Charles County communities here include St. Charles, St. Peters, O'Fallon and Dardenne Prairie. Downstream, its water passes through the Cuivre Island-Mississippi River, Bolter Island-Mississippi River and Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
